title: Guarded Canary Runner Start Executor Extension
claim: FP-MCP-318 should extend forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate by exactly one final guarded stage: when valid approval, valid operator-local clearance, valid scoped execution enablement, fresh runner capability observation, and valid evidence/preflight bindings exist for the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple, the enforced executor may perform one bounded runner-start attempt and then stop.
summary: FP-MCP-317 proved the live FP-MCP-316 executor can advance from fresh approval through clearance and scoped enablement while stopping before runner start. FP-MCP-318 is the next implementation target and should route the final runner-start gate through the same single enforced executor path. It must preserve the narrowed default action surface, prevent direct operator selection of adjacent runner-start tools, and make runner start a sequencer-selected, preflight-bound, one-attempt action only.
caveats: This is a packet proposal/checkpoint, not the implementation itself.
All previous approvals, clearances, and scoped enablements should be treated as expired before any runner-start test.
This is the first extension that may contact the runner start endpoint, so implementation and testing must be stricter than prior local-gate packets.
boundaries: Must use only forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate for the final start path.
Must not expose forgepilot_start_remote_runner_request directly in the default narrowed guarded surface.
Must consume approval only if the runner-start attempt is actually invoked according to the existing start contract.
Must not start arbitrary OpenCode outside the remote runner contract.
Must perform at most one bounded runner-start attempt.
Must stop immediately after the runner-start result is returned.
Must preserve global disable switch and preflight gating behavior.
Must record or preserve pre-start/post-start evidence according to the existing runner-start contract.

requiredPreconditions: valid scoped approval for the FP-MCP-295 tuple
valid operator-local clearance for the same tuple
valid operator-local scoped execution enablement for the same tuple
sequencer nextRequiredGate indicates final start stage
structuredRecord.expectedStopPoint: after one bounded runner-start attempt result
explicitlyOutOfScope: arbitrary OpenCode start outside runner contract
continuing beyond the returned runner-start result
